obituaries.full_text:
In addition to her husband, she is survived by: sons, Harvel Brown (Bernadette) 
 and Greg Miller (Rasheen); daughters, Nichelle Coles (Shawn), Shannon Harris 
 and Niquita Harris-Leary; sisters, Helen "Becky" Street (Herbert) 
 and Nellie I. Durham (Carl); fourteen grandchildren, seven great grandchildren, 
 and numerous aunts, uncles, nieces, nephews other relatives and friends.
